experiment: Held-out (M9 progress): fleet Round-0/1 decisions, outcomes recorded by the fleet's own deterministic scorecard gates — NOT by the engine's author
independence_note: No row carries escalation_class or strongest_pass: the by-hand routing annotations (the leakage source flagged in M3) were deliberately omitted, so recorded-routing and blind replay are identical for this corpus. Outcomes were recorded by the fleet harness (SPEC §10 gate: score >= baseline - 0.05 AND >=2x faster where latency measured; 5-fold CV; fresh-set validation) before the Wrongness Engine existed.
